name: Committee on Aging Agenda, July 28, 2026
agenda_text:
COMMITTEE ON AGING
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  REGULAR MEETING

  JULY 28, 2026 – 6:30 P.M.
  LIVE OAK PARK COMMUNITY CENTER– 10144 BOGUE ST. TEMPLE CITY

  AGENDA

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS COMMITTEE ON AGING:
If you wish to address the Committee on Aging, please complete a Speaker Request Form,
indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the Secretary. There will be a 3- minute
time limit on each speaker, unless waived by Commission. You have the opportunity to
address the Committee on Aging at the following times:

  •  AGENDA ITEM - at the time the Committee on Aging considers the agenda item.

  •  NON-AGENDA ITEM - at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the Committee on Aging values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the
  Commission cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Committee to take action
on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

 1.  CALL TO ORDER - Chairperson Seitz

 2.  ROLL CALL

  Committee Members
  Judith Gunther  Janice Robertson
  Jerry Jambazian Carole Rodenbucher
  Lucy Liou  Ann Seitz

  Ex-Officio Members
  Tom Chavez, Councilmember
  Joanne Rosso, Parks and Recreation Commissioner

 3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 4.  REAPPOINTMENT OF COMMITTEE MEMBERS AND REORGANIZATION

  The Committee will consider the reappointment of eligible members and elect a
  Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson for the 2026 – 2027 term.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Parks and Recreation Director
 COMMITTEE ON AGING AGENDA  Page 2
July 28, 2026

  Recommendation: Approve Committee reappointments and elect Chairperson
  and Vice Chairperson for the 2026 – 2027 term.

5.  PRESENTATIONS

6.  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The Committee of Aging will now hear public comments regarding items not listed
  on the agenda. The procedure to address the Committee of Aging is highlighted
  on the first page of this agenda.

7.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All consent calendar items may be approved in a single motion as recommended
  unless removed for further discussion. If members of the Committee or persons
  in the audience wish to discuss any matters listed on the Consent Calendar, please
  address them at this time.

  Recommendation: approve item A per recommendations

  A.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The Committee on Aging is requested to review and approve the Minutes
  of the Regular Committee Meeting of April 28, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve

8.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS

  A.  COMMITTEE ON AGING GOALS FOR 2026

  Continued discussion and update on the current status of 2026 goals.

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Parks and Recreation Director

  Recommendation: Receive and file.

9.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  SUBCOMMITTEE FOR COMMITTEE INTERVIEWS

  Create a subcommittee to conduct committee applicant interviews and
  make recommendations to the Commiittee on Aging at a future meeting.
 COMMITTEE ON AGING AGENDA  Page 3
July 28, 2026

  Presentation:  Adam Matsumoto, Parks and Recreation Director

  Recommendation: Receive and file.

10.  COMMUNICATIONS FROM STAFF

11.  ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA
  If a member of the audience would like to address the Committee on any item,
  which does not appear on the agenda, please do so at this time. Please fill out a
  speaker request form and present to the Secretary.

12.  COMMITTEE ON AGING AND EX-OFFICIO MEMBERS ITEMS SEPARATE
  FROM THE REGULAR AGENDA

  Committee members at this time have the opportunity to discuss anything not listed
  on the agenda.

13.  ADJOURNMENT

  The next Committee on Aging meeting will be held on Tuesday, October 27, 2026
  at 6:30 p.m.

  Notice: Staff reports or written documentation relating to each item of business of this Agenda are
  available for viewing on the City’s website at www.templecity.us and are on file in the Office of the
  City Clerk located at City Hall, 9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California, and available for
  review during regular business hours.

  In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in
  this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171. Notification 48 hours prior to the
  meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

  I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing
  agenda was posted on the Civic Center bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

  Jennifer Venters, Parks & Recreation Secretary
  Sign and Posted: (5:00 p.m.)
